messages:
signal-gateway-bot: Alert: delivery failures detected for paging channel 'sms/oncall' for service svc-payment. 3 failed pushes in last 2m, last_success ~12m ago. Creating thread.

sam.k: Is this just notification errors or are pages actually not going out to oncall?

leila: Seeing 502s from upstream when pushing to pager endpoint. sample log:```ERROR push failed status=502 body="upstream reset by peer" svc=signal-gateway request_id=8f4b2c```

michael: Also seeing spike in external 502s and a related increase in payment-api 502s around same window. customer reports coming in.

dana: Oncall for svc-payment is @maria — Maria, did you get paged?

maria: No SMS or call yet. Oncall app shows nothing.

sam.k: OK manual page to Maria via Twilio UI now. @leila can you try a restart of signal-gateway to clear proxy connections?

leila: Running rollout: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/signal-gateway -n infra`
```deployment.apps/signal-gateway restarted```

signal-gateway-bot: Restart initiated. Will monitor push_success metrics.

leila: After restart pushes resumed but delayed. push_success_rate for svc-payment: 1/10 -> ~8/10 in first 30s, now ~95% after 2m.

michael: Customer impact summary: payments ingestion error rate spiked from ~0.2% -> ~4% between 12:05-12:18 UTC. Retries recovered most requests; some latency increased. No confirmed data loss so far.

dana: We should flip critical oncall routing to fallback notifier until we patch. @sam.k can you set the flag?

sam.k: Set `notify.use_fallback=true` for svc-payment in feature flags. Sending test pages now.

maria: Received test page from fallback and acked. I'm on incident. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-197 and attached initial timeline.

leila: Preliminary root cause: upstream pager-proxy connection pool exhaustion + long keepalive + burst traffic causing TCP resets and 502s. Hotfix candidates: reduce keepalive, tighten pool limits, add circuit breaker to external provider calls.

sam.k: Action items: 1) fallback routing (done). 2) Hotfix RFC and quick patch (assigned to leila). 3) Postmortem owner = leila. 4) Notify vendor support and open ticket.

maria: I'll triage customer-impacted accounts and start comms if we need to notify customers.

michael: Added temporary alert: trigger if push_success_rate < 95% for 5m. Also increased log retention for failed pushes for 1h.

leila: Enabling debug flag to capture upstream response bodies for failed pushes for 1h to aid triage. Will revert after.

sam.k: Thanks all — will update status page and ping #all-hands with a brief summary once we have the postmortem draft.

leila: Quick note: follow-up improvement — add a health-check for upstream provider socket reuse and fail open to fallback.

maria: Acknowledged. I'm running initial mitigation now.

sam.k: Closing live mitigation loop — monitoring 10m post-fix. If metrics hold we'll downgrade to P1->P2 and continue postmortem work.
